text: Detect existing project design tokens (design/tokens.css, tokens.css, CSS variables) and stack (HTML or React/JSX) before writing code; never edit design/ files or import unrequested external libraries.

Every mechanism <svg> MUST declare an explicit numeric viewBox with width="100%" and preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet", keeping all nodes and <text> labels inside >= 24px safe margins so nothing clips at 390px or 1440px.
Every mechanism <svg> MUST organize markup into <defs> (gradients/markers/filters) and semantic <g> layers (layer-backdrop, layer-tracks, layer-signals, layer-nodes, layer-labels).
Bind all SVG fill, stroke and stop-color attributes to CSS custom properties (var(--...)), url(#...), currentColor or none; never hardcode raw #hex or rgb() literals inside SVG attributes.
Support light and dark modes (:root, [data-theme="dark"] and prefers-color-scheme: dark) with >= 4.5:1 label text contrast and >= 3:1 node/track contrast.
Animate signals using stroke-dashoffset or GPU transform/opacity keyframes; never animate layout geometry or unthrottled heavy filters.
Provide an accessible Play/Pause control (button with aria-pressed, >= 44x44px hit target, visible :focus-visible ring) that freezes and resumes all animations cleanly.
Honor @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) by disabling continuous signal travel while keeping directional arrows and stage clarity intact.
Every mechanism <svg> MUST include role="img", aria-labelledby, <title> and <desc> summarizing the architecture for screen readers.
Keep every <text> label readable (>= 12px viewBox units) and unobstructed; for Khmer labels, set letter-spacing: 0 and generous vertical padding so subscripts never clip.
Support keyboard-accessible stage focus or step-through with an aria-live="polite" status readout when the mechanism has discrete stages.
checklist: Discrete stages can be stepped through or focused by keyboard and update an aria-live="polite" summary.

text: Never invent architecture components or protocol steps; when the request gives no subject or mechanism, ask 1-2 concise clarifying questions and emit no <svg>.

Refuse requests meant for 3D isometric cutaways (figure-craft), full-page scroll showcases (motion-craft), product UI screens (ui-craft), standalone token systems (design-system), or CSS polish (ui-polish) with one concise redirect sentence.
Verify rendered output via engine/lint-svg.mjs (when available) and in a real browser at 1440px and 390px in light, dark and reduced-motion modes with zero errors and zero horizontal overflow.
checklist: Rendered browser checks at 1440px and 390px pass in light, dark and reduced-motion modes with zero errors and zero horizontal scroll.
